Small Changes, Big Results for Diners
Restaurants in Melbourne have never looked more stylish. But do their dining rooms actually make customers want to come back? Research shows that a comfortable and attractive dining room encourages guests to stay longer and order more, thereby raising the average amount spent at each table. Below are several affordable updates that can make any dining room more inviting and boost sales.
Lighting is the easiest place to start. Replacing harsh overhead lights with warm, adjustable lamps can make a room feel calmer and more intimate in the evening.
Add a touch of nature cheaply with fresh flowers. Flowers not only add color to each table but also give off a pleasant scent that guests notice as soon as they sit down. If fresh flowers need to be replaced too often, high-quality silk flowers are an acceptable alternative.
Think about creating a small waiting lounge near the entrance. Giving arriving guests a cozy place to sit with a drink while their table is being prepared helps them feel welcomed instead of rushed. This can be as simple as placing a few armchairs beside a low shelf of magazines.

Creating a Classroom That Works
Language schools in Seoul are spending more than ever on new technology. But are their classrooms actually helping students learn? Educators report that a pleasant and well-organized classroom keeps learners focused and eager to participate, thereby improving test results. Here are some affordable adjustments that teachers can make to create a better learning space.
Rearranging desks is a free and effective first step. Placing desks in small groups rather than in straight rows encourages students to speak up and share ideas.
Let in more daylight. Natural light not only reduces eye strain but also helps students stay alert during long lessons. If a room has few windows, bright full-spectrum bulbs are a reasonable replacement.
Set aside a quiet reading corner. Providing a calm spot where students can review material on their own during breaks is essential for building independent study habits. This can be as easy as placing a rug, a few cushions, and a small bookcase in one corner of the room.

책상 배치를 바꾸는 것은 돈이 들지 않는 효과적인 첫걸음이다. 책상을 일렬이 아니라 작은 모둠으로 배치하면 학생들이 말을 하고 생각을 나누게 된다.
햇빛을 더 들여라. 자연광은 눈의 피로를 줄일 뿐 아니라 긴 수업 동안 학생들이 정신을 차리고 있게 도와준다. 교실에 창문이 적다면 밝은 자연광 전구가 적당한 대체품이다.
조용한 독서 공간을 따로 마련하라. 쉬는 시간에 학생들이 혼자 복습할 수 있는 조용한 장소를 주는 것은 스스로 공부하는 습관을 기르는 데 필수적이다. 이는 교실 한쪽에 깔개, 쿠션 몇 개, 작은 책장을 두는 것만큼 쉬울 수 있다.

Have you ever been told to write a detailed report with only a day or two to finish it? You probably felt stressed and wondered where to begin. We asked several professionals how they handle this common situation.
"An essential first step is to make a simple outline before writing a single paragraph," said Marcus Leland, a business writing instructor. "Of course, there are many ways to organize a report. Just avoid spending hours on fancy charts or design. Most readers prefer a clear, plain layout."
"I always begin by asking myself what decision the report should help the reader make," said Priya Natarajan, a management consultant.
"In other words," added Dr. Henrik Solberg, a lecturer in business communication at Oslo Commerce College, "you should know precisely what you want your readers to do after they finish reading."
Carla Mendes, an account manager at Brightline Appliances, agreed. "When I write a proposal to win a new client, I think carefully about who will be reading it and which facts will matter most to that particular customer," she said.

오답 분석: (A) 은퇴 발표는 없다. / (B) 병원 정책 변화 얘기가 아니다. 병원은 바르가스 씨의 이전 직장이다. / (D) 예산 제안서를 요청하지 않는다. budget은 경력 소개에만 나온다.

questions.q: What is indicated about Ms. Vargas?
options: She worked at Ridgeview Medical Supplies before.
She studied medicine at Pinecrest Hospital.
She helped an organization cut its costs.
questions.explain:
유형: PART 7 · 사실 확인
정답 (D) She helped an organization cut its costs.
정답 근거: 정답 포인트 — 지문 "she reduced the hospital's supply costs by 20 percent" → 보기 "helped an organization cut its costs". reduced costs가 cut costs로, the hospital이 an organization으로 바뀌었다.
오답 분석: (A) 리지뷰에는 이제 새로 들어온다. / (B) 파인크레스트 병원은 공부한 곳이 아니라 재무 일을 한 곳이다. / (C) 헤일 씨를 채용했다는 말은 없다.
해석: 바르가스 씨에 대해 언급된 것은? (D) 그녀는 한 기관의 비용 절감을 도왔다.

questions.q: How long did Ms. Vargas serve as finance director at Pinecrest Hospital?
questions.explain:
유형: PART 7 · 세부 사항
정답 (B) 6 years
정답 근거: 정답 포인트 — 지문 "She was then named finance director and held that position for six years" → 보기 "6 years".
오답 분석: (A) 5년은 라킨 앤 로스에서 감사인으로 일한 기간이다. / (C) 8년은 구매 예산을 관리한 기간이다. / (D) 14년은 병원 전체 근무 기간이다. 숫자를 바꾼 함정이다.
해석: 바르가스 씨는 파인크레스트 병원에서 얼마 동안 재무 이사로 일했는가? (B) 6년

questions.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "That background includes experience at both a private firm and a hospital."
questions.explain:
유형: PART 7 · 문장 삽입
정답 (B) [2]
정답 근거: 정답 포인트 — 주어진 문장의 That background는 앞 문장의 "a strong background in accounting and business management"를 가리킨다. 그리고 뒤에 회계법인(private firm)과 병원(hospital) 경력이 차례로 나온다. 그래서 [2]가 알맞다.
오답 분석: (A) [1]: 아직 background가 나오지 않아 That background가 가리킬 대상이 없다. / (C) [3]: 병원 재무 이사 얘기 중간이라 회계법인 경력을 다시 묶기에 늦다. / (D) [4]: 비용 절감 성과 뒤라 That background가 가리킬 문장과 멀다.
해석: 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 알맞은 곳은? "그 배경에는 민간 기업과 병원 두 곳에서의 경력이 모두 포함된다." (B) [2]
